rows: Update and maintain the solution in test and production environments. Document processes and configuration changes as needed
Pertains to BU Admin for areas within their realm
Maintain core system settings, as needed. Typically changes to core settings are minimal after implementation
Field Management changes. Updating system verbiage when identified / appropriate
Maintain images (Used for branding, showcases etc.)
Document (PR, PO & Invoice) changes. Typically changes to core settings are minimal after implementation
Create / Maintain User Roles as needed
BU Admin: Can see all Roles but only edit their own. Cannot create new Roles

Maintain and/or create forms.
Edit forms created during implementation in case wording or field changes are needed
Create new forms, if desired

Supplier Administration.
Creation / assignment of Supplier Classes
Approval of Hosted Supplier Pricing
Maintenance of Supplier access by Campus
Ship To & Bill To Addresses

Accounts Payable:
Maintain core system AP settings
Maintain Invoice matching Rules and Tolerances
User Maintenance; User profile maintenance & role assignment
Maintain account codes values. Includes researching integration issues, User accessibility and/or value relationships when necessary.
Integrations: monitoring and troubleshooting. Occasionally there maybe issues with Budget-Checking and/or Document Exports to the FMS/ERP
Workflow approver assignments; via Rules and/or Chart of Account fields
Manage order failures and communicate with appropriate parties to resolve any failures (this may include JAGGAER support and/or suppliers)

Act as central point of contact within the solution for issues that cannot be resolved internally; Communicate issues to JAGGAER help desk, track issues resolution and communicate resolution to SUNY help desk or end users when appropriate.

Monitor and review upcoming JAGGAER functional changes to the application by attending Web-conferences, teleconferences or other JAGGAER-sponsored activities (New releases come out three times a year.)
Lead and support testing during major releases: making sure everything is functioning normally, including new functionality (some new features are on by default and cannot be turned off)
Develop or help develop internal communication and updates to training when appropriate.

Pertains to BU Admin for areas within their realm. BU Admin can verify new functionality and prepare internal (Campus) documentation, however activating new functionality will likely be a Global Admin function

Act as point of contact for JAGGAER Client Success Manager (CSM). The CSM is your main point of contact and can help you with any application-related questions or concerns and can also serve as a support point of escalation.

paragraphs: 1. JAGGAER estimates 1 FTE for Global System Administration responsibilities
2. Based on Business Unit Sys Admin estimated at 5 – 10 hours per week
